definitions: A punctuation mark indicating a pause between parts of a sentence.
Used to separate items in a list.
Used to set off introductory elements or clauses.
Used to separate independent clauses joined by a coordinating conjunction.
Used to set off nonessential clauses or phrases.
examples: She bought apples, bananas, and oranges.
After the rain, the sun came out.
He is a kind, generous man.
I like to read, and I like to write.
My brother, who lives in New York, visited me.
